text:
JSON_REQUEST
Description
Triggered upon successful parsing of valid JSON content in the body of an HTTP (or HTTP/2) request message
Examples
when
JSON_REQUEST
{
log
local0.
"JSON content in message body is now accessible"
set
root
[
JSON
::
root
]
...
}
